parsed.g: Find the number of reviews that the store has received that mention the term 'not useful'
P_t: Navigated to the Magento Admin Dashboard (Step 1)
Opened the MARKETING menu and identified the 'All Reviews' link under User Content (Step 1/2)
R_t: Successfully navigate to the All Reviews page (Marketing > User Content > All Reviews)
Apply a search/filter for the term 'not useful' in the review text
Count and report the number of reviews matching the term 'not useful'
parsed.e_t: The ground-truth DOM at Step 3 shows the Magento Admin login page (adminhtml-auth-login), not the All Reviews page. The page displays a login form with username and password fields and a 'Sign in' button. The agent has been logged out or the session has expired. The page title is 'Magento Admin' and the URL context is the admin login page.
C: The agent must re-authenticate (log in) before it can access the All Reviews section
The agent must navigate to Marketing > User Content > All Reviews after logging in
The agent must filter reviews by the text 'not useful' to count matching reviews

F_t.cause: The click did not navigate to the All Reviews page; the observation still showed the Dashboard. The navigation failed silently, likely because the menu click did not register a page load.

F_t.action: Attempted to type 'not useful' into textbox [2267] at Step 3
F_t.cause: The ground-truth DOM shows the admin login page, not the All Reviews page with a review filter textbox. The agent's session expired or was never established on the reviews page, so node [2267] did not exist in the actual DOM.

K_t: The All Reviews section is located at Marketing > User Content > All Reviews in the Magento Admin navigation
The agent's session appears to have expired — the ground-truth DOM at Step 3 shows the login page
To filter reviews by text content, the agent needs to use the filter/search functionality on the All Reviews grid page
The agent must log in again before attempting to access any admin pages
